signals.title: Codex preserves Guardian authorization across history compaction by separating user-message revision from history generation
signals.title_zh: Codex 通过分离用户消息修订号与历史代际，使 Guardian 授权跨 History Compaction 保持有效
signals.summary: Codex now tracks a host-owned user-message revision separately from conversation-history generation, preserving an otherwise valid Guardian review across compaction and internal context injection while invalidating it for genuine user input and rollback.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在把 Host 拥有的用户消息修订号与会话历史代际分开跟踪：Compaction 与内部上下文注入不会无端使有效 Guardian Review 失效，而真实用户输入与 Rollback 会触发失效。

researchValue.failure: Treating any model-visible history rewrite as a new authorization event invalidates safe cached reviews and conflates host context maintenance with user intent changes.
researchValue.mechanism: Version genuine user authority separately from mutable conversation-history generation and bind review reuse to that user-owned revision.
researchValue.implication: Durable authorization needs its own provenance clock; context mutation alone should neither grant nor revoke authority.

signals.title: Codex makes planning-tool exposure opt-in and removes matching prompt guidance when the capability is absent
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Planning Tool 暴露改为显式启用，并在能力不存在时同步移除对应 Prompt 指导
signals.summary: Codex defaults update_plan to disabled and removes bundled update_plan guidance across model, collaboration, multi-agent, compaction, prewarm and goal-continuation prompts unless the tool is explicitly enabled, while preserving unrelated custom instructions.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 默认关闭 update_plan；只有显式启用工具时，模型、协作、多 Agent、Compaction、Prewarm 与 Goal Continuation Prompt 才保留对应指导，同时保留无关的自定义指令。

researchValue.failure: Prompt text can promise a capability that the runtime does not actually expose, causing false plans and authority confusion.
researchValue.mechanism: Generate capability-specific instructions from actual enabled tool registration rather than maintaining an unconditional prompt copy.
researchValue.implication: Agent capability declarations and model instructions should be derived from the same admitted capability state.

signals.title: Google ADK skips rewound invocations when deciding what agent to resume
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在决定恢复哪个 Agent 时跳过已经 Rewind 的 Invocation
signals.summary: ADK changes agent-resume selection so invocations already marked as rewound are not treated as current continuation candidates.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 修改 Agent Resume 选择逻辑，使已经被标记为 Rewound 的 Invocation 不再被当作当前 Continuation 候选。

researchValue.failure: A recovery search that ignores rewind state can resume an invalidated execution branch and re-authorize work that was intentionally rolled back.
researchValue.mechanism: Exclude rewound invocation identities from resume-candidate resolution.
researchValue.implication: Rollback must alter future admission, not merely edit historical presentation.

signals.title: Google ADK prevents duplicate durable user events when an invocation is retried
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在 Invocation Retry 时阻止重复追加 Durable User Event
signals.summary: ADK now skips appending the same user event again when an invocation is retried, separating retry execution from durable input creation.
signals.summary_zh: ADK 现在在 Invocation Retry 时跳过重复追加同一个 User Event，把重试执行与 Durable Input 创建分离。

researchValue.failure: Invocation retry can duplicate durable user input, corrupting event order and making replay indistinguishable from a second user action.
researchValue.mechanism: Make input-event append idempotent across retries while allowing execution to retry independently.
researchValue.implication: Retry identity and durable-input identity must be separate if event logs are to remain authoritative.

signals.title: CrewAI propagates model-call policy denials through every execution path instead of degrading them into provider failures
signals.title_zh: CrewAI 让模型调用策略拒绝沿所有执行路径 Fail-closed 传播，而不是降级成 Provider Failure
signals.summary: CrewAI closes multiple paths where pre-model-call denials were swallowed, mislabeled as provider outages, retried, or allowed to continue without plans or knowledge; explicit policy aborts now propagate as deliberate stops across planning, guardrails, knowledge and retry boundaries.
signals.summary_zh: CrewAI 修复多个策略拒绝被吞掉、误标为 Provider Outage、被重试或在缺少 Plan/Knowledge 时继续执行的路径；显式 Policy Abort 现在会穿过 Planning、Guardrail、Knowledge 与 Retry 边界作为受控停止传播。

researchValue.failure: A deny that is caught as a generic exception can be retried or degraded, converting a policy decision into eventual execution.
researchValue.mechanism: Use a typed deliberate-stop exception and re-raise it across every broad error boundary that otherwise fails open.
researchValue.implication: Call-time authorization is only as strong as its end-to-end exception semantics; every caller must preserve deny identity.

signals.title: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit places deterministic policy interception directly on the runtime action path
signals.title_zh: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit 把确定性策略拦截直接放到 Runtime Action Path
signals.summary: Microsoft's toolkit describes a stateless policy engine that intercepts agent actions before execution, combines capability gating with identity and dynamic trust, and integrates through framework-native middleware rather than replacing the agent framework.
signals.summary_zh: Microsoft Toolkit 描述一个 Stateless Policy Engine：在 Agent Action 执行前拦截，结合 Capability Gating、Identity 与 Dynamic Trust，并通过 Framework Native Middleware 接入而不是替换原 Agent Framework。

researchValue.failure: Static agent capability lists do not decide whether a concrete action is permitted at execution time.
researchValue.mechanism: Insert deterministic, stateless policy mediation before execution and bind decisions to identity, trust and capability context.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise agent governance is converging on a runtime mediation layer between reasoning and side effects.

signals.title: UiPath Maestro Flow treats the governed business process as the durable production artifact around coding agents
signals.title_zh: UiPath Maestro Flow 把 Coding Agent 外围的受治理业务流程本身作为 Durable Production Artifact
signals.summary: UiPath Maestro Flow lets supported coding agents design, run, observe and govern an end-to-end business process as a single durable artifact intended to move from prototype to production without rebuilding the process boundary.
signals.summary_zh: UiPath Maestro Flow 让受支持的 Coding Agent 围绕同一个端到端业务流程 Artifact 进行设计、运行、观测与治理，目标是从 Prototype 到 Production 不重建流程边界。

researchValue.failure: Agent-generated automation can remain a prototype if the production process model, observability and governance are separate artifacts that must be rebuilt later.
researchValue.mechanism: Use one governed process artifact across design, execution, observation and production transition while agents remain replaceable builders or workers inside it.
researchValue.implication: Digital-employee products may compete on durable process ownership more than on the agent model itself.

signals.title: SymTrace shows that unguided multi-agent reruns often resample failures rather than causally repair them
signals.title_zh: SymTrace 表明无引导的多 Agent 重跑常常只是在重新采样失败，而不是因果修复
signals.summary: SymTrace replays a recorded prefix up to an intervention anchor and regenerates only downstream execution. On 536 human-annotated failures across three MAS frameworks, unguided reruns reproduced failures 67.97% of the time but repaired only 6.90%; symptom-driven intervention repaired 20.15%.
signals.summary_zh: SymTrace 将记录过的执行前缀重放到 Intervention Anchor，只重新生成下游轨迹。在 3 个 MAS Framework 的 536 条人工标注失败轨迹上，无引导重跑的失败复现率为 67.97%，修复率仅 6.90%；症状驱动干预修复率达到 20.15%。

researchValue.failure: Full reruns change upstream stochastic decisions, so a later success cannot prove that the intended repair fixed the original failure.
researchValue.finding: Controlled replay exposes a large gap between stochastic rerun success and causal repair effectiveness.
researchValue.mechanism: Freeze the execution prefix, anchor the intervention point, and regenerate only downstream behavior so repair effects are attributable.
researchValue.implication: Agent recovery evaluation should preserve the failed execution as evidence and distinguish replay, resampling and repair.

signals.title: Harness context construction can elevate low-privilege content into user-level instructions
signals.title_zh: Harness Context Construction 会把低权限内容提升成 User-level Instruction
signals.summary: The study defines instruction privilege escalation in agent harnesses: low-level attacker-controlled content is re-encoded by context construction as higher-privilege instructions. Attacks achieved all 13 objectives on six harnesses with unrestricted execution and all 13 on the three harnesses offering automatic permission review.
signals.summary_zh: 研究定义了 Agent Harness 中的 Instruction Privilege Escalation：低权限攻击者内容被 Context Construction 重新编码成更高权限指令。在无限制执行下，6 个 Harness 的 13/13 攻击目标全部成功；在提供自动权限审查的 3 个 Harness 上同样是 13/13。

researchValue.failure: A model-side instruction hierarchy can be defeated before inference if the harness drops source provenance while rebuilding context or handing work to a subagent.
researchValue.finding: Automatic permission review can also authorize the escalated request because it receives a transcript where attacker content already appears user-authored.
researchValue.mechanism: Preserve instruction-origin provenance and privilege across context construction, handoff, persistence and review rather than inferring authority from the final message role.
researchValue.implication: The security boundary is partly in the harness serializer and handoff layer, not only in the model or permission reviewer.

signals.title: User-authored standing permission policies reduced prompts but blocked less agent overreach than per-action review
signals.title_zh: 用户自定义 Standing Permission Policy 虽减少 Prompt，却比逐动作审查更难阻止 Agent Overreach
signals.summary: In a study of 113 non-professional users supervising an 18-action simulated day with seven overreach actions, reusable user-authored consequence policies blocked 20.1 percentage points less overreach than per-action HITL and 14.5 points less than automated per-action review. Users chose ask for 114 of 140 rules, returning many decisions to runtime.
signals.summary_zh: 在 113 名非专业用户监督包含 7 个 Overreach Action 的 18 动作模拟日实验中，可复用的用户自定义 Consequence Policy 比逐动作 HITL 少阻止 20.1 个百分点的越界，比自动逐动作审查少 14.5 个百分点。140 条规则中有 114 条选择 Ask，使大量决定重新回到 Runtime。

researchValue.failure: A reusable preference policy can look like durable authorization while users still want runtime judgment on most consequential actions.
researchValue.finding: Standing rules reduced runtime prompts but did not provide stronger overreach protection than per-action approval in this experiment.
researchValue.mechanism: Separate reusable preference defaults from runtime commitment authority, preserving an explicit ask path where consequence-specific approval is still required.
researchValue.implication: Enterprise approval design should not collapse preference, policy and final action authorization into one configuration layer.
